title: Complete bounded acceptance scans beyond 32 coherent never-started registrations
outcome: A claim with more than 32 coherent never-started registrations can reach the appropriate evaluation flow without a permanent ScanIncomplete refusal, while request work remains bounded and newer failures or incoherent evidence are preserved.
acceptance: A claim with more than 32 coherent never-started registrations can reach the appropriate evaluation flow without being permanently refused solely because those registrations exhaust one scan.
The request remains bounded, and genuinely started newer failures or unreadable or incoherent evidence cannot be skipped in favor of an older pass.
Behavioral tests cover more than 32 coherent never-started registrations and preserve newest-result and failure selection.
